what: Union Pacific runs one of the two big freight railroads in the western two-thirds of the US, hauling grain, chemicals, cars, coal and shipping containers.
customers: Farm, chemical, automotive, energy and retail shippers.
moat: A rail network that cannot be rebuilt, with only one major competitor in its territory and a cost edge over trucks on long hauls.
risks: Economic slowdowns and falling coal volumes
opportunities: Operating margin of 40% with return on invested capital of 15%
Rail is the cheapest way to move heavy freight overland, and no new tracks will be built
A dividend yield near 2% with consistent large buybacks
watch: Volume growth by commodity and the operating ratio.
